mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts above 2100 thousand units and retail sales above 350000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2100 and RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110.0 signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns during late-cycle expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 2200 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production above 110.0 signals strong manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth rate above 200 thousand jobs signals strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
